issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Reference Appendix B Aggregate Functions; CQL 1.5.3 Logical Specification Aggregate Operators
issues.evidence: Before fix, translate_cql accepted invalid static aggregate operands: AllTrue({{1, 2}}) -> logicalAllTrue([[1, 2]]), Avg({ToString(5)}) -> list_aggregate(list_transform([ToString(5)], TRY_CAST...), Avg({DateTime(2012, 1, 1)}) -> list_aggregate over a DateTime string, and Min({Tuple { a: 1 }, Tuple { a: 2 }}) -> list_min(json_object list). Aggregate signatures require Boolean for AllTrue/AnyTrue and supported ordered/numeric element types for other aggregates.
issues.root_cause: _static_list_element_types() returned None for nested list, tuple, interval, typed instance, constructor, as assertion, and known conversion/function-return elements, so static aggregate validation treated known invalid operands as unknown dynamic sources.
issues.resolution: Classify those statically knowable list element expressions before aggregate validation while preserving conservative behavior for unknown dynamic sources; add regression coverage.
